text:
taylor_sales: Hey team — prospect FinEdge sent an updated security questionnaire. They require keys split across two HSM clusters (east/west) with non-replayable proxying and a failover path that never exposes unwrapped keys. Also asked about rotation windows (weekly, 22:00 PST), latency impact, and whether we support Shamir-style key splitting. Any blockers for the POC?
jordan_se: Short answer: we support BYO-KMS via an HSM proxy. Proxy can be sidecar or managed. We DO NOT perform Shamir splitting server-side — that must be client-side. We can route/sign against two HSMs and offer a managed failover policy, but dual-control workflows need client logic. I can drop a sample proxy config for the POC. :+1:
jordan_se: ```
proxy:
  mode: dual-hsm
  route_policy: primary-east,secondary-west
  wrap_mode: customer-wrap
  timeout_ms: 500
```
devon_security: Quick asks: do they require FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestation? If yes we need vendor attestation docs and HSM model. Also clarify rotation semantics — zero-downtime key swap vs scheduled maintenance? Zero-downtime requires test vectors and a rollover strategy.
amy_sre: Latency note: expect an additive ~8-12ms per request when proxying to external HSM in another region; cross-AZ sync adds variance. If they insist on synchronous dual-sign, that will multiply tail latency. For Dedicated we can set per-route SLO overrides. For the POC we can spin a mocked HSM to measure.
taylor_sales: Legal flagged "no unwrapped plaintext" in logs. Customer wants synchronous dual-signing for compliance. Pricing: they asked for a "per-sign" fee vs our usual usage token pricing — what's the quote approach?
jordan_se: For POC we can do flat monthly for reserved proxy + per-100k ops after free tier. Need ops/day to size. I'll attach pricing doc: https://redwood.example/pricing/byok-proxy (internal).
taylor_sales: Ops estimate from FinEdge: 3M sign ops/day peak. Also audit log retention: 13 months.
devon_security: Audit logs: we can ship metadata to their SIEM but only log digests/hashes for signatures. No plaintext or unwrapped key material. Need SOC2 addendum and legal review for retention >12 months.
amy_sre: Onboard checklist (minimal):
```
1. Allowlist IPs: 198.51.100.10/32
2. Upload HSM certs to console
3. Run sign-test vectors (script attached)
4. Run chaos failover
5. Confirm audit logs shipped to SIEM (digests only)
```
deploy-bot: Pipeline: private-proxy-stub v2.3 deploy triggered — build: https://ci.redwood/build/1234 :gear:
taylor_sales: Devon — can security sign off on the no-Shamir limitation? Customer insists Shamir is a must-have.
devon_security: We cannot claim native Shamir splitting. Recommend customer implement Shamir client-side using their KMS client library or a vetted library. We'll provide a sample implementation and compatibility guide. Also need HSM vendor compatibility list for the SOW.
jordan_se: I'll prepare a short demo (managed proxy + client-side split) and a 2-week POC SOW draft. Should we include failover stress testing as a billable add-on?
taylor_sales: Yes — include stress/failover testing as billable. Need ops hour estimate.
amy_sre: Estimate: 2 engineers x 5 days for setup/test/failover (~80 engineer-hours), plus 3 days for security attestation review. Add time for legal review on retention and SOC2 addendum.
taylor_sales: Perfect. I'll update the RFQ and send to the customer. I'll attach the SOW draft once Jordan posts it. Thanks all. :pray:
